task: Add a per-connector copilot-analytics.json preferences store and analytics gate, wire it into the copilot-cli-otlp and copilot-chat-otlp plugins, and expose --copilot-cli-otlp/--copilot-chat-otlp flags on `codemie proxy analytics` (EPMCDME-16396 Copilot analytics parity).

component_scope.label: XL
component_scope.affected: Copilot analytics preferences store (new), Copilot analytics gate (new), copilot-cli-otlp plugin, copilot-chat-otlp plugin, proxy analytics command (connector selection and store abstraction), analytics-status collector/formatter
component_scope.layers: Service (core agents), Agent-Tool (OTLP plugins), API (CLI command), DB-Persistence (JSON preferences file)

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: privacy opt-out must fail closed on corrupt preferences, hook behavior must never block Copilot Chat when analytics is opted out (fixed in a review follow-up), reader/writer file-shape validation had to be unified (review follow-up), atomic temp-file write with merge preserving sibling connector records, precedence ordering across preferences and connector scope
technical_risk.mitigation: mirrors the existing claude-code-otlp gate and preferences precedence shape, separate file so connect cannot wipe exclusions, shared validator for read and update, extensive unit tests plus a real-filesystem disable matrix test

key_reasoning.reason: Six components: new preferences store, new gate composing it with CopilotConnectorScope, two OTLP plugins wired to the gate, the proxy analytics command refactored around a per-connector store abstraction, and the status collector/formatter. Base L, bumped to XL because the change affects multiple agent plugins.

A privacy opt-out must fail closed on corrupt preferences yet never block Copilot Chat sessions, prompts or tools. The diff includes two review follow-ups (unified file-shape validator, no-block on opt-out), showing subtle behavior. A direct precedent exists in the Claude gate and preferences, which keeps this at L rather than XL. Base M, bumped for the privacy/compliance red flag.
12 files (7 modified, 5 new) across 4 directories, of which 6 are tests. Diffstat shows 1369 insertions and 69 deletions. Maps to XL by file count.
CLI (API), Service (gate and preferences logic in core), Agent-Tool (two OTLP plugins) and a new JSON persistence file. No schema migration or cross-system calls.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: affects multiple agents (copilot-cli-otlp and copilot-chat-otlp plugins plus the shared analytics command).
Technical Risk bumped from M to L: privacy opt-out / compliance-style requirement with fail-closed semantics.
